AI Notes.value: Moscow-based CGI/motion studio (formerly White Russian, now branded WRS.design) working on 3D animation, motion design, product video and key visuals for major brands. Co-founded by Stas Antipov, Roma Lyubimov and Dima Baraulya. Small studio (2-10), Autonomy 5. Client list includes Yandex (Alice Station speaker CGI, Yandex Music visual identity, Yandex Cloud), T-Bank (liquid metal card design), Megafon Bank, J.Lindeberg x Ecco (footwear CGI), Extremum GG (esports branding), Kaspersky, Baracoda. Studio operates at full creative scope: concept, CGI, motion, rendering and soundscaping. Original domain whiterussian.studio now redirects to an unrelated AI tool (p20v.com); studio migrated to wrs.design as canonical site. Instagram confirmed as @wrs.design (16.9k followers), NOT the earlier guess @whiterussian.studio. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/wrs-design.
